answer: Each agent identity must post a timber bond of 400 marks and hold a hardware credential that the registry binds to one physical device. Creating a fake identity locks 400 marks, forfeits 100 percent of that bond when fraud is proven, and requires a 14-epoch exit wait. Splitting into N identities costs N times the bond, and independent jurors tracing shared registrants recover the collateral held in the vault, including any assets stored in a canyon partition.
